votes.motion: Approve Work Session Meeting Minutes for Tuesday, December 1, 2020 and the Airport Bond Minutes for Tuesday, January 19, 2021
votes.description: The Council approved the official minutes from the December 1, 2020 work session and the January 19, 2021 Airport Bond meeting.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (West End Alley Vacation adjacent to properties at 740 West and 746 West 900 South)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed partial alley vacation near 740-746 West 900 South and deferred any final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Zoning Map Amendment at 706-740 West 900 South and 710-739 West Genesee Avenue)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezone from M-1 to R-MU for properties along 900 South and Genesee Avenue and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Zoning Amendments at approximately 2903 South Highland Drive)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed Sugar House Master Plan and zoning map amendments at 2903 South Highland Drive and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Rezone at 1301 and 1321 South State Street)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezone from CC to FB-UN2 at 1301 and 1321 South State Street and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and defer action to a future Council meeting (Zoning Amendments at Lincoln Street and 200 South)
votes.description: The Council closed the public hearing on the proposed rezone from R-2 to RMF-35 for properties at Lincoln Street and 200 South and deferred final action to a future meeting.

votes.motion: Continue to meet remotely without an anchor location under HB5002
votes.description: The Council ratified the determination to continue holding remote meetings without a physical anchor location as authorized under HB5002.

votes.motion: Approve the consent agenda, including setting a public hearing date for RMF-30 text amendments and approving the appointment of David Wirthlin to the Library Board
votes.description: The Council approved the consent agenda, which set March 16, 2021 as the public hearing date for proposed RMF-30 zoning text amendments and confirmed David Wirthlin's appointment to the Library Board through June 30, 2024.
